name: Krimighna Vati

sections.introduction: Krimighna is made from two words, krimi which means worms and ghna means destroying, Krimighna means killing or destroying parasites or worms. Krimighna Vati is an herbal formulation which aids in treating intestinal worms and parasites.
sections.ingredients:
Mucuna pruriens 
 Ferula asafetida 
 Schrebera swietenioides 

 Method of Preparation 
 Clean and separately grind all the ingredients properly. Mix all the powders well and add water and make tablets of 250 mg each and let them dry. After the tablets have hardened, store them in an airtight container away from heat, light and moisture. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 It is an herbal formulation which is used in various disease conditions. As the name indicates it is used in the management of intestinal worms and parasites. Krimi means worms or parasites. Krimighna means killing of worms / parasites. It is used in the management of all types of digestive disorders like bowel problems such as occasional diarrhea, bloating, gas distension and worm infestation. It helps to improve the digestion and enhances the appetite. Helps to digest ama (undigested food) and balances all doshas. Apart from these it is useful in skin problems like rashes, itching, discoloration and many other related issues. It is useful to remove the toxins from the body and helps to detoxify whole body naturally.
sections.indications:
Intestinal parasites/worms 
 Low digestive fire 
 Vomiting 
 Bloating 
 Flatulence
sections.dosage: 1 tablet two times every day after meals with lukewarm water.
sections.contraindications:
It should be taken under strict medical supervision. 
 Over dosage should be avoided. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

Krimighna Vati 
 Introduction 
 Krimighna is made from two words, krimi which means worms and ghna means destroying, Krimighna means killing or destroying parasites or worms. Krimighna Vati is an herbal formulation which aids in treating intestinal worms and parasites. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Mucuna pruriens 
 Ferula asafetida 
 Schrebera swietenioides 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Clean and separately grind all the ingredients properly. Mix all the powders well and add water and make tablets of 250 mg each and let them dry. After the tablets have hardened, store them in an airtight container away from heat, light and moisture. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 It is an herbal formulation which is used in various disease conditions. As the name indicates it is used in the management of intestinal worms and parasites. Krimi means worms or parasites. Krimighna means killing of worms / parasites. It is used in the management of all types of digestive disorders like bowel problems such as occasional diarrhea, bloating, gas distension and worm infestation. It helps to improve the digestion and enhances the appetite. Helps to digest ama (undigested food) and balances all doshas. Apart from these it is useful in skin problems like rashes, itching, discoloration and many other related issues. It is useful to remove the toxins from the body and helps to detoxify whole body naturally. 
 Indications 
 
 Intestinal parasites/worms 
 Low digestive fire 
 Vomiting 
 Bloating 
 Flatulence 
 
 Dosage 
 1 tablet two times every day after meals with lukewarm water. 
 Contraindications 
 
 It should be taken under strict medical supervision. 
 Over dosage should be avoided. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
